summary: Give coding agents shared project instructions, with Claude Code hooks for destructive commands, secrets, lint feedback and formatting.
description: Give coding assistants one project guide for commands, architecture and unfinished work. AGENTS.md is shared across agents; the Claude Code adapter adds hooks for command and secret guards, lint feedback and formatting the current session's edits. Fill the guide from the project as built. These hooks guide local agent work and do not sandbox code or replace project tests.
seoDescription: Shared AGENTS.md project instructions with a Claude Code adapter for command guards, secret checks, lint feedback and formatting.

projectExamples.title: CLI contributor guide
projectExamples.description: Document the real build and test commands of a Go utility so coding assistants can make changes consistently. The guide must be filled from the finished project.

projectExamples.title: Web repository agent onboarding
projectExamples.description: Give assistants a shared map of the Python backend and React frontend. Claude Code additionally gets the fragment's local guard and formatting hooks.

requests: help different coding assistants follow the same project instructions
document commands and architecture so agents can work in this repository
stop Claude from writing credentials or running destructive commands
show lint errors after edits and format the agent's changed files
